title: Deciding to go home and Willie Lewis's band
summary: Carter wanted to see the Swing Era at home; Willie Lewis's Paris group later saw members go to Cairo.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well, how did you then begin to think about going back to the States? When did that arise? How did that occasion come up?
Well, things were happening. I guess that was the Swing Era, huh?

Yes, and I thought I'd like to come back and see, you know, look the scene over and see if maybe I could do something, you know, with it, on it or in it. Or as part of it. And I also did think, though, at that time that I might be returning to Europe, to England at some time ...
So the time had come to see what was going on back home, anyway.
Through all this, was Willie Lewis still playing in Paris? Was that more or less that same group.
I thought it was at that point or around there that they went to Cairo, isn't it?
I think so. I think so.
When Bill Coleman went and Herman Chitterson and those guys.
Bill Coleman, Herman Chitterson, yes. Joe Hayman, yeah.
Well, Willie Lewis himself didn't go, as I recall.
I don't think so. But several members of the band went.
